title: wss: credential expiry leaves event streams on
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md:135 lets the server 'treat subsequent requests as unauthenticated' instead of closing, but ephemeral events are pushed, not requested, so they keep flowing. draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-wss-00.md and draft-atwood-jmap-scene-wss-00.md do not address expiry. Also draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md mischaracterizes RFC 8887's choice as a MAY (only the 1008 code is MAY).
close_reason: All three: server that does not close on expiry MUST NOT deliver further ephemeral events. vtc/scene: 1008 SHOULD on close (chat keeps its MUST). Fixed chat-wss MAY characterization.
